rules.condition: RACL is disabled in the configuration
rules.statement: Every register access must be permitted and no access may be rejected for an access-control reason.
The alert sender of gpio and the alert receiver of the wrapper must both use the synchronous clocking scheme, with no synchronizer flops on the differential pairs.
Ping requests must never be issued.
GpioAsyncOn is passed through unchanged from ot_gpio_nnc to gpio (legal values 0 or 1, default 1); when 1, 2-flop synchronizers are instantiated on all GPIO inputs.

GpioAsHwStrapsEn is passed through unchanged to gpio (legal values 0 or 1, default 1); when 1, HW straps sampling logic for GPIO inputs is enabled at initial cold boot, and HW_STRAPS_DATA_IN behaves per its register description.
The verification must be run in every combination of GpioAsyncOn and GpioAsHwStrapsEn that the run set selects; the default (1, 1) is the Earl Grey top-level configuration.
